title: TITLE OF THE EXAM
intro: Main line: the eleven workflow steps of SKILL.md. Left, purple: the olympiad standard each step serves (S1-S8). Right, green: the check that shows the step is done. Copy this file for each exam, set the title and storageKey, and build it with make_checklist.py --profile author.

S1.name: S1 Three problems, 30 marks, 5 hours
S1.note: three independent problems of 10 points, 3-5 parts each; a quick version has one

S2.name: S2 Physics, not mathematical virtuosity
S2.note: every problem has modelling questions; most marks go to (M) steps

S3.name: S3 Standard mathematics
S3.note: only mathematics the reader has; any other tool in one line of Useful information and in the toolbox

S4.name: S4 Concepts explained in syllabus terms
S4.note: the paper's language translated: standard word first, the paper's term in parentheses

S5.name: S5 Olympiad layout and marking
S5.note: context before each question, boxed subquestions with points, answer sheets, itemized marking

S6.name: S6 Research topics
S6.note: the papers are the problem source, at IPhO-like difficulty for the reader

S7.name: S7 Independent problems, one master text
S7.note: each problem restates its model; symbols and labels identical in translations

S8.name: S8 Moderation
S8.note: scripts, cold read, trial solve, recomputation, sign checks; an expert review when the exam matters

c-question.name: One sentence for the question and one for the answer, per paper

c-language.name: Every term a cold reader flags is in the language map

c-open.name: Every open link is O-calc or O-theory; the shared gap is one sentence

c-independent.name: Each problem can be solved without the others

c-questions.name: One verb, a checkable answer, 0.2-2.5 points per question

c-cold.name: Cold read: no uninterpretable term, no blocked step, the paper's question recognized

c-figures.name: Figures show the set-up only; every symbol of a figure is defined in the text

c-tags.name: Marking lines add up and every number is tagged (C) or (M)
c-tags.ref: check_booklets.py: marking sums and modelling share

c-toolbox.name: A toolbox entry for every tool above the reader's level

c-sheets.name: Answer sheets generated after the last change to the questions

c-guide.name: Study guide built and cross-checked with the question paper

c-checker.name: check_booklets.py: zero errors, every warning read

c-scripts.name: A script recomputes every derivable answer and every toolbox result

c-signs.name: Every sign and convention checked a second way

c-render.name: Two compiles, zero overfull boxes, every page looked at

c-leaks.name: Leak review by hand: no sentence answers a question

c-public.name: No unpublished data, internal paths or file names in public versions

nodes.label: Step 3
nodes.title: Map the chain of objects; classify the open links

nodes.label: Step 4
nodes.title: Split the chain into three independent problems

nodes.label: Step 6
nodes.title: Write the introductions and Useful information

nodes.label: Step 8
nodes.title: Write solutions, tagged marking, appendices and toolbox

nodes.label: Step 9
nodes.title: Make the answer sheets and the study guide

footer: Tick a standard when the exam meets it, and a check when it has been run and its result read. A reminder (dashed) repeats a standard at a later step; ticking it ticks the first one too.
